rtcOperationalSourceNotes.direction: Forward A turns left and D turns right; reverse reverses the yaw response. S is brake then reverse, not a parking brake. At very low speed steering is weaker and zero speed gives no turn.
rtcOperationalSourceNotes.steeringTimingLimit: At a steady 10 km/h, full settled steering is about 49.5 degrees/s; at 20 km/h about 89.1 degrees/s. W accelerates and steering ramps, so these source rates are not fixed-duration navigation guarantees. Use short visible steering corrections and re-check the actual map/road.
rtcOperationalSourceNotes.stopping: With W/S released, speed decays at 4 m/s². Long S holds reverse the car; HUD speed magnitude alone does not establish travel direction.
rtcOperationalSourceNotes.fullMapArrow: North-up map; the single front apex is opposite the inward V notch between the rear wings. Do not select a farthest vertex by eye as the front. The minimap rotates so the car front remains up.
rtcOperationalSourceNotes.ribbon: The local strip has no directional chevrons. It refreshes about every 1.5 s for short routes and may leave a tail behind the moving car between refreshes. Legal heading/carriageway routing may initially lead away from the beacon to a junction; distance growth alone is not a new navigation bug.
rtcOperationalSourceNotes.flight: Airborne and descent guidance use the beacon distance with ground ribbon hidden. A second Space begins descent; landing is not immediate. Source requires grounded, non-descending, non-gliding state for handover.
rtcOperationalSourceNotes.recovery: Wait until recovery glide settles before judging the camera, heading or forward controls. A safer road placement can increase route distance; this alone is not a failure.
rtcOperationalSourceNotes.simultaneousArrowInput: The global keydown handler tracks event.code values. If ArrowUp and ArrowLeft states overlap, input() produces throttle 1 and steer -1, equivalent to W+A. Focus restored to the minimap after closing does not exclude these keys. Game source cannot verify whether the native wrapper delivered overlapping events; no browser/input inspection was performed.
rtcOperationalSourceNotes.highSpeedSteering: At 77 km/h, full settled steering is approximately 61 degrees/s; a 1.7–1.8 s hold could rotate about 100 degrees before ramp/collision effects. At a collision stop, zero speed yields no steering rotation. Observed handling difficulty alone is not a confirmed key-chord defect.

explicitHandover.acrossRoadCondition: Horizontal distance <24 m and a route exists with route length > distance*4+60; otherwise normal <8 m gate.
visibleProtocol: Approach the customer beacon using the current road route, coast or briefly brake to a stop and wait for the actual Hold E / ACT to hand over prompt.
Hold E about 1.0–1.2 s while the prompt remains valid.
Capture reward toast, wallet/progress change and delivery-state clearance. Distance zero, proximity or a held key alone is not completion.
explicitHandover.lateOrders: No time or heat threshold blocks interaction or completion in source. Heat affects tip; zero remaining time is not a failed/expired order. Surviving slices and heat determine payout, so do not predict the exact reward from distance alone.
explicitHandover.nextOffer: Completion queues an offer after 2500 ms. Pausing/modal/map ownership defers it; the queue is checked again after resume. A controlled immediate-pause/resume post-handover check is useful regression coverage, not evidence that PT-011 has reopened.
explicitHandover.zeroSlices: Zero slices/Pizza ruined does not block handover. completeDelivery awards round(base fare * 0.3) when no slices remain, and still advances completed-delivery progress. Capture the actual result rather than inferring it from this formula.

expectedFromSource: Actual Close map button dismisses the map; Escape, M and P close it as well. P inside the map closes that overlay rather than stacking Pause.
Focus is managed within the map and restores to the minimap after closing. Picker Cancel and map Close have distinct behaviors.
openMap sets paused; frame returns while map.open before advancing the order timer. The close callback resets the clock delta. This is source intent, not a newly observed browser result.
mapControlsAndTimer.highValueVisibleCheck: After explicit map Close, separately press P and verify Paused before lengthy analysis. If verifying timer suspension, take immediate before/open/wait/close/after HUD samples without driving; tool/inspection time outside the overlay must not be confused with held-input time.
mapControlsAndTimer.priorEvidence: Three actual Close map clicks passed in the preceding RTC collection round; no current close-button failure is established by source inspection.

postCloseSpaceFollowUp.candidateDistinctIssue: Post-close flight shortcut conflicts with restored minimap focus
postCloseSpaceFollowUp.sourceFinding: Map Close invokes DialogFocus.hide, which restores prior focus or falls back to minimap. Focused minimap Space handler prevents default, stops propagation and opens the map; the window flight handler does not receive that event.
postCloseSpaceFollowUp.browserStatusAtAnalysis: One Narsingi observation; controlled repeat requested separately. Source does not itself confirm a browser defect.
postCloseSpaceFollowUp.proposedControlledComparison: Click minimap, click actual Close, press Space; compare with same sequence followed by clicking the visible driving scene before Space. Observe charge, open map and actual flight HUD separately.
